verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a documented 'Selecting an Audit Partner' page, which suggests an in-product flow for choosing an auditor, and its quickstart says teams can work with their auditor in-platform. However, the evidence is only a page title: it does not show a vetted auditor network, booking through the vendor, or any published timeline. missing for 10: evidence of a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm, ability to book the audit through Sprinto, published audit timeline expectations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
